english.note: Use 怪 as the all-purpose spoken choice when holding someone responsible for a bad outcome.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for blaming someone or finding fault with them.
Use this to say that someone or something is to blame for a result, especially a negative one.

examples.english: Don’t blame me; this time it was really an accident.
examples.traditional: 唔好怪我，呢次真係意外。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 gwaai3 ngo5 ni1 ci3 zan1 hai6 ji3 ngoi6

examples.english: Don't accuse me; I was just following the rules.
examples.traditional: 唔好怪我，我都係跟規矩做㗎咋。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 gwaai3 ngo5 ngo5 dou1 hai6 gan1 kwai1 geoi2 zou6 gaa3 zaa3

examples.english: We can thank ourselves for losing this match—we didn’t prepare properly.
examples.traditional: 今次輸波怪我哋自己準備不足。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 syu1 bo1 gwaai3 ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 zeon2 bei6 bat1 zuk1
